dataset.name: FloodNet-Supervised v1.0
dataset.orientation_policy: Apply RGB EXIF orientation (release values 1/3); masks already use annotation/display coordinates. Visually verified.

overlap.method: Candidates: train frames within ±frame_window IDs plus top embedding neighbours (ImageNet ResNet-18, processed RGB). Verification: ORB keypoints on EXIF-oriented greyscale originals, cross-checked Hamming matches, RANSAC homography; verified when inliers, inlier ratio and covered evaluation-frame fraction pass the thresholds.

limitations: This is a research prototype using one event/region, not an operational disaster-response service.
The target is flooded buildings and flooded roads. Other includes floodwater, vegetation and non-flooded infrastructure.
Evaluation is at 256 x 256 with aspect-ratio padding excluded. Thin boundaries may disappear during resizing.
Pixel coverage does not measure physical area, flood depth, building counts or road passability.
Three training seeds share one fixed 25% image subset: the spread reflects training randomness only, and three replicates are too few for a significance test.

Most official test frames, and nearly all test frames containing flooded targets, share ground with a training frame (verified by keypoint matching). The test split therefore mostly measures performance on areas already seen in training, not on a new flood area.

protocol.primary_metric: Mean of flooded-building and flooded-road IoU from pooled split confusion counts
